## Type Test Report HX-360

Halvorsen Industrial Systems - Department - owner: Otto Lammi

## 1. Summary

Type testing of the HX-360 was performed at the Lyon Systems test lab between 2 and 24 May 2026.

Test engineer: Otto Lammi. Witnessed by Quality: Aukusti Ollikainen.

## 2. Results

Results against the product requirement specification:

| Test | Requirement | Result | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hydrostatic pressure | 1.5x rated, 10 min | No leakage | Pass |
| Vibration at BEP | < 3.5 mm/s RMS | 1.8 mm/s | Pass |
| Noise at 1 m | < 78 dB(A) | 72 dB(A) | Pass |
| Efficiency at BEP | >= 78% | 81.1% | Pass |
| Endurance run | 1,000 h | 1000 h | Pass |
| Seal leakage | < 5 ml/h | 0.5 ml/h | Fail |
